decisionsTitle: The team's and the members' invitation says the sign-in steps in order and leaves only after Zitadel was asked; «Echipa» says who sends what (amending §141 and §123)
decisionsSection:
**The owner, 2026-11-19, two days before Saturday's race:** «am o alta problema a invitarea voluntarilor in echpa, cumva trebuie un delay intre mailurile de logare, sau sa fie instructiunile mai clare» — *another problem inviting volunteers to the team: somehow there should be a delay between the sign-in emails, or the instructions should be clearer*.

**What was wrong.** A press on «Echipa» that reaches Zitadel sends two emails: Zitadel's own invitation, to choose a password, and the club's (§141). The club's said «dacă nu ai încă un cont, îl faci din pagina de autentificare» — true only without the key — and nothing of Zitadel's email; the member's said only «Dacă ai primit și un mesaj de la Zitadel». Both came in the club's name. Worse, Zitadel's sign-in page — its new login (`docs/RUNBOOKS.md` § Staff sign-in) — sends **a new invite code each time** somebody whose account has no password yet types their address (our account is made with the address verified, §123, which is that page's condition), and a new code replaces the one before. So whoever read the club's email first, pressed «Intră în backoffice» and typed their address got a third email, and the link in Zitadel's first one stopped working. And the club's row was due the moment it committed, before the action asked Zitadel: a drain or the pinger in between sent it first.

**Decision — the steps, in the email.** `staffInvitation` and `memberInvitation`, in both languages, say the sign-in as numbered paragraphs (`templates.ts#signInStepsWords`), by `signInSteps` in the payload, written at the press:

- `zitadel` — the press asks Zitadel for the account: «Primești două emailuri: acesta, de la noi, și unul de la Zitadel, sistemul nostru de autentificare, cu subiectul „Invitație la …” (caută-l și în Spam). Pașii, în ordine:» — 1. open Zitadel's email, press its button and choose the password; 2. then press «Intră în backoffice» («Intră în zona membrilor») and sign in with the address and that password. Then «Ai deja cont (ai mai intrat la noi)? Sari peste pasul 1.» and, in bold, «Nu încerca să intri înainte de pasul 1»: until the password is chosen, every attempt — and «Resend code» on the sign-in page — sends another email from Zitadel with another code and cancels the one before; with several, use the newest.
- `self` — no key, or Zitadel did not make the account: 1. press the button; 2. on the sign-in page choose «Register new user» and make the account with exactly this address, or sign in directly with an account that exists.

Zitadel's email is named by its own subject — its default «Invite user» text, `Invitație la {{.ApplicationName}}` / `Invitation to {{.ApplicationName}}`, with the club's name the call sends (`staff-identity/domain/zitadel-invite.ts`) — in the row's language in both halves, the language the account was made with. The sign-in page's labels are named as the page shows them: the new login has no Romanian, so a Romanian reads «Register new user» and «Resend code». The privacy paragraph stays. A row queued before this has no `signInSteps` and reads as `zitadel`, what every environment with the key had asked of Zitadel.

The brief proposed the warning as «Nu apăsa „Am uitat parola”»: Zitadel's page has no such link, and its «Reset Password» leaves an invite code alone. The trap is the sign-in itself, and «Resend code», so that is what the email names.

**Decision — the order.** When the press will ask Zitadel (`STAFF_AUTH_MODE=provider` and the key set), the invitation is queued with `next_attempt_at` one minute ahead (`INVITATION_HOLD_MS`) — the column the claim already waits on, a first attempt included, as a family sitting's messages wait (`EnqueueEmailParams.notBefore`, §519) — and the action lets it go the moment Zitadel answers (`releaseInvitationHold`), before its response: «Adaugă», each member of «Adaugă mai mulți membri» as Zitadel answers for that member, and «Retrimite invitația». The drain the enqueue scheduled runs after the response (`after()`), so it — or «Trimite acum»'s own drain (§540) — finds the row due, and no drain or pinger took it before Zitadel was asked. Zitadel's answer says which steps are true: an account made, one found without a password (a new code) or one found with its password keeps Zitadel's steps; a refusal rewrites them to `self`, since no email from Zitadel is coming. The minute is the bound for an action that never got to the release: the row is due at its end, for the next pass; a members' press longer than the minute (a slow Zitadel, fifty members three at a time) lets the later members' invitations leave at its end, still with Zitadel's steps. A failed release is logged, never the press's. Under the default «Când pleacă emailurile» (the scheduled pass, §513) the club's email leaves with the next pass, minutes after Zitadel's; under «imediat», seconds after Zitadel was asked — when Zitadel's own email leaves is Zitadel's, so the text is written to be right in either order.

**Decision — an account that already signs in.** Zitadel refuses an invite code to an account that has its password (its check `CreationAllowed`, error `COMMAND-EF34g`), which «Adaugă» showed as `failed` — a warning that Zitadel refused the account of somebody who could sign in. It is its own answer now, `ready` (`zitadel-users.ts#isAlreadyInitialised`): the verb happened (a green toast, `PROVIDER_DONE`), only the club's email goes, and its «Sari peste pasul 1» fits. The members' report has the same line.

**Decision — «Echipa» says who sends what.** After «Adaugă» and «Retrimite invitația», one line by Zitadel's answer (`staff-identity/domain/invite-lines.ts`): «Adăugat. Primește două emailuri: întâi de la Zitadel, pentru parolă, apoi de la noi, cu pașii.» (`invited`; `exists` adds that Zitadel sent a new code), «… primește doar emailul nostru, cu pașii, și intră cu parola pe care o are» (`ready`), «… un singur email, de la noi, cu pașii ca să-și facă singur contul» (no key), «Adăugat, dar Zitadel nu a făcut contul ({reason}): primește doar emailul nostru …» (`failed`); the resend says the same as «Trimisă din nou …». The members' report words each member's line the same way. The toast names Zitadel's email for `exists` too, which Zitadel sends.

**Decision — the club's words.** A text the club wrote for the invitation (§247) goes with Zitadel's steps only: written for the press that asks Zitadel, it would send a person with no key to an email that is not coming, so the person's own steps are the platform's alone, as the family's confirmation is (§520). «Setări» → «Emailuri» previews that shape on a second card of each type, after the first.

**The owner's to do.** `SETUP.md` §37 step 6: Zitadel's «Invite User» message text written in Romanian and English in Zitadel's console, keeping the subject `Invitație la {{.ApplicationName}}` the club's email names it by, so both emails speak the same language.

**Refused.** Holding the club's email for minutes after Zitadel answered, so that Zitadel's surely lands first: under «imediat» the drain after the response would find nothing due and the email would wait for the pinger's next pass, and «Trimite acum» promises now (§540) — the steps are right in either order instead. Queuing the invitation only after the Zitadel call: the row and its invitation are one transaction (BR-REQ-060-01 criterion 11), and Zitadel is never asked for an address the service has not accepted. Making the account with an unverified address, which would stop the new login from sending a code at each attempt: it changes what §123 decided and adds Zitadel's «verify your email» message — a question for the owner. A third shape for `failed`: the person's own steps are right for the common refusal, the key's missing membership (§288), where no account was made.

**Not in this change.** Zitadel's own throttling of codes; a second reminder email.

No dependency, no migration. Both languages; the backoffice's lines within 200 characters.

**Held by** `tests/unit/notifications/invitation-steps.test.ts` (both messages, both languages, both shapes, the steps' order, Zitadel's subject in both halves, the privacy paragraph, the club's words with Zitadel's shape only, both previews), `tests/integration/auth/invitation-hold.test.ts` (the hold, the release, the bound, a refusal's steps, another person's row untouched, the members' and the resend's holds, the row rendered, and through the three presses Zitadel asked while the invitation is held), `tests/unit/staff/zitadel-users.test.ts` (`ready`), `tests/unit/staff/invite-lines.test.ts` and `staff-page-roles.test.ts` (each answer's line, in both languages, as the page draws it), `tests/unit/staff/member-accounts.test.ts`, `tests/integration/notifications/press-receipt.test.ts` (Zitadel's email in the toast for `exists`, not for `ready`), and the updated `email-copy-prefill`, `role-boundaries`, `member-tiers`, `no-hardcoded-values`, `emailing-presses` and `feedback-notice` tests.
changelogLine: - **The team's and the members' invitation says the sign-in steps in order** — the club's email says that two emails come, Zitadel's (named by its subject, «Invitație la …») and ours, and numbers the steps: open Zitadel's email and choose the password, then press «Intră în backoffice»; it warns that trying to sign in before step 1 sends a new code and cancels the first, and without the Zitadel key the steps are the person's own. Our email leaves only once Zitadel has answered, and «Echipa» says after each press what the person receives — an account that already has a password gets our email alone, with no warning. §NNN.

specsCriteria.text: Amends criterion 11. Given «Adaugă», «Adaugă mai mulți membri» or «Retrimite invitația» on «Echipa» while Zitadel is the provider and its key is set, when the row is added or the invitation queued again, then the `STAFF_INVITATION` or `MEMBER_INVITATION` is queued in the same transaction with `signInSteps: "zitadel"` in its payload and `next_attempt_at` one minute ahead, so no claim takes it before Zitadel is asked; the action lets it go once Zitadel answered for that person, before its response — due at once, its steps rewritten to `self` when Zitadel did not make the account — and a row nothing let go is due at the minute's end; a press that asks Zitadel nothing (no key, another provider) queues it with `signInSteps: "self"`, due at once, and «… fără invitație» queues nothing and asks nothing (`tests/integration/auth/invitation-hold.test.ts`) (2026-11-19, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Given a colleague's or a member's invitation, when it renders, then in both languages its body says the sign-in as numbered paragraphs by its `signInSteps`: `zitadel`, and a row with none — the two emails and who sends each, Zitadel's named by its subject in the row's language («Invitație la …» / «Invitation to …») in both halves, 1. Zitadel's email and the password, 2. the button and the address, «Ai deja cont (ai mai intrat la noi)? Sari peste pasul 1.», and that a sign-in tried before step 1, or «Resend code», sends a new code that cancels the one before; `self` — 1. the button, 2. «Register new user» with exactly this address; the privacy paragraph is kept; the club's own words for the message are sent with `zitadel` only, and «Setări» → «Emailuri» previews both shapes (`tests/unit/notifications/invitation-steps.test.ts`) (2026-11-19, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Given «Adaugă» or «Retrimite invitația» on «Echipa», when the page comes back, then one line says what the person receives by Zitadel's answer, in both languages: `invited` or `exists` — two emails, Zitadel's first, then the club's with the steps; `ready`, an account that already has its password (Zitadel refuses it a code, `COMMAND-EF34g`) — the club's email alone, with a green toast; `unconfigured` — one email, the club's, with the steps to make the account; `failed` — the club's email alone, with Zitadel's reason; the members' report words each member's line the same way, `ready` among them, and the toast names Zitadel's email for `invited` and `exists` only (`tests/unit/staff/invite-lines.test.ts`, `tests/unit/staff/staff-page-roles.test.ts`, `tests/unit/staff/zitadel-users.test.ts`) (2026-11-19, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

batchLine: the team's and the members' invitation says the Zitadel sign-in steps in order and leaves after Zitadel was asked
